Subject: Clarifying the Documentation Submission Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to clarify our current documentation submission process to ensure everyone is on the same page.

To summarize, all completed documentation should be sent to the designated email address, [DocumentationEmail@example.com], by the 15th of each month. Please make sure to include your full name, project name, and a brief summary of the document’s content in the email body. Attachments should be in either .pdf or .docx format and not exceed 10MB.
